answer: A vouch ledger makes every new key borrow credit from an old one. A newcomer joins only if an existing key posts a 40 POA bond on it. Each epoch an auditor samples 1 in 10 vouched keys; if a sampled key shares a funding source with its voucher, the bond burns. The whisper window is the 2 epochs a bond stays locked before release, so late audits still bite. A signal flag from any audit marks the voucher with an umber tag that bars it from vouching again. Attacker pays about $4,000 in burned bonds this epoch for 1,000 fakes.
